en: Huh? Who's there? Can't a Gym Leader have one quiet afternoon on the cape?
Er... I think I'd better be going. See you, Misty!
He ran off! Honestly. And you're a trainer, aren't you? I can tell. You came to Cerulean for my Badge.
Fine. If my afternoon's spoiled anyway, I might as well battle. I'll be waiting at the Gym!
